query:
UPDATE issue SET title = coalesce($2, title), body = coalesce($3, body),
                    labels = coalesce($4, labels),
                    assignee_id = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE assignee_id END,
                    parent_id = $7, project_id = $8, milestone_id = $9, updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1
